definition: A vector asset groups stable identity, logical size, pivot, paths, gradients and metadata in a JSON-compatible record.
integration: Shared authoring record for Python, SVG and browser Canvas output.

definition: Path geometry is expressed by move, line, quadratic, cubic and close commands with fixed arity.
integration: Provides a small deterministic interchange grammar.

definition: Drawing commands are rejected until a subpath has an explicit move command.
integration: Prevents malformed path state during procedural authoring.

definition: Paint strings may reference validated linear or radial gradients local to an asset.
integration: Avoids duplicated color-stop data across paths.

definition: Quadratic segments recursively subdivide until midpoint deviation is within tolerance.
integration: Produces inspection/collision-ready polylines from vector curves.

definition: Cubic segments recursively subdivide against a caller-selected geometric tolerance.
integration: Supports deterministic curve approximation without third-party geometry libraries.

definition: Rectangles, rounded rectangles, circles, polygons and stars compile to the common path/asset record.
integration: Speeds practical game-asset creation and template generation.

definition: An asset is written as stable SVG path/defs records with logical viewBox and optional background.
integration: Provides portable inspection and artwork interchange.

definition: An axis-aligned box stores finite minimum/maximum corners and exposes bounds/translation operations.
integration: Base collider, camera bound and tile collision primitive.

definition: A circle stores finite center and positive radius with exact AABB bounds.
integration: Compact player, pickup and hazard collider.

definition: Convex polygons are tested on edge-normal axes and return minimum-overlap normals.
integration: Provides penetration and direction for convex response.

definition: AABB, circle and convex polygon pairs dispatch to typed narrow-phase routines with normal reversal as needed.
integration: Keeps gameplay collision code shape-agnostic.

definition: Two colliders interact only when each layer is accepted by the other mask.
integration: Separates players, world, pickups, hazards and custom groups.

definition: Sensor colliders create lifecycle contacts but skip positional and impulse resolution.
integration: Supports pickups, triggers and non-blocking zones.

definition: A moving AABB computes slab entry/exit times against a static target over a displacement.
integration: Offers a continuous query for fast box motion.

definition: Shape bounds are inserted into deterministic fixed-size cells for query and candidate-pair generation.
integration: Reduces all-pairs collision work for 2D scenes.

definition: Gameplay reads named scalar actions rather than raw device events.
integration: Decouples game logic from keyboard/gamepad/touch details.

definition: Bindings cover keys, pointer buttons/axes, gamepad buttons/axes and touch axes.
integration: One project supports desktop, controller and mobile controls.

definition: Resolved action values apply signed deadzone remapping and optional unit-range clamping.
integration: Prevents drift while retaining analog control.

definition: Current and previous values classify down, pressed and released states by action threshold.
integration: Provides deterministic button-edge gameplay.

definition: Two scalar actions form a vector whose magnitude is capped at one.
integration: Prevents faster diagonal movement.

definition: Resolved frames serialize with values, prior values, thresholds, pointer position and frame index.
integration: Supports reproducible tests and replay-oriented tooling.

definition: Track key times must be finite and strictly increasing.
integration: Eliminates ambiguous interpolation intervals.

definition: Interpolation uses validated linear, smooth, polynomial, sine, back and bounce easing curves.
integration: Gives reusable motion profiles without code generation.

definition: Clip-local time maps global playback time through declared boundary behavior.
integration: Supports repeated and reversible animation deterministically.

definition: Two clip samples blend common property paths and preserve one-sided properties.
integration: Allows smooth animation transitions.

definition: Ordered predicates choose state transitions with optional crossfade durations.
integration: Separates gameplay parameters from clip selection.

definition: Sample keys address nested mappings through dot-separated paths.
integration: Connects generic clips to serialized component records.

definition: Tile IDs map to stable name, solidity, movement cost and metadata.
integration: Centralizes gameplay meaning for map cells.

definition: Multiple same-sized layers store tile IDs over shared origin and tile size.
integration: Supports collision, decoration and gameplay overlays.

definition: Characters map to tile IDs while rectangularity and unknown symbols are validated.
integration: Makes small level prototypes easy to author and diff.

definition: Map origin and tile size define reversible cell-center/world transformations.
integration: Connects pathfinding and entity placement.

definition: A* searches non-solid cells with optional diagonals and tile movement costs.
integration: Provides dependency-free navigation for grid games.

definition: Contiguous compatible solid cells merge into maximal axis-aligned rectangles.
integration: Reduces collider count for tile-based levels.

definition: Scientific note names map to frequency relative to configurable A4.
integration: Enables musical cue authoring without sampled assets.

definition: Attack, decay, sustain and release values are validated as finite non-negative controls.
integration: Shapes Web Audio oscillator cues.

definition: A cue combines waveform, frequency/sweep, duration, volume, noise and envelope.
integration: Creates compact effects with no network assets.

definition: Cue references are placed at beats under a declared BPM and sequence length.
integration: Provides lightweight procedural music loops.

definition: Cue and sequence IDs are unique and sequence cue references are validated.
integration: Prevents broken browser audio references.

definition: Entities combine stable IDs, tags, active state, metadata and typed or custom components.
integration: Provides data-driven scene/gameplay composition.

definition: World time advances only by a declared positive fixed delta.
integration: Supports repeatable headless simulation.

definition: Custom systems register in named phases with priority and stable-name ordering.
integration: Allows project-specific gameplay without modifying core integration.

definition: Body type controls inverse mass and integration while retaining common velocity/material records.
integration: Supports players, moving hazards and level geometry.

definition: Current and prior contact sets produce enter, stay and exit events with ordered pair IDs.
integration: Provides deterministic triggers and gameplay hooks.

definition: Movement actions set velocity and an edge-triggered dash applies duration/cooldown state.
integration: Provides a ready-to-use arcade controller.

definition: Hazards apply bounded damage and directional knockback subject to per-target cooldown.
integration: Implements reusable damage interactions.

definition: Sensor contact increments a declared state key, emits an event and may defer entity destruction.
integration: Implements score/items without unsafe mutation during collision iteration.

definition: Components provide timed despawn, clamp/bounce/wrap constraints and smoothed bounded following.
integration: Covers common 2D game-loop utilities.

definition: World state serializes with schema and canonical numeric normalization for stable SHA-256 identity.
integration: Supports regression tests, persistence and divergence checks.

definition: Project records declare the `ugts-kc-game-project-3.9` schema and runtime metadata.
integration: Creates one source of truth for tools and runtimes.

definition: Validation collects independent structural and asset/audio/tilemap reference issues with paths.
integration: Improves actionable authoring feedback.

definition: A scene deep-copies initial state and reconstructs entity components into a fresh world.
integration: Connects editable project data to simulation.

definition: Sorted normalized project JSON is hashed for reproducible build identity.
integration: Links source project to build reports.

definition: CLI templates create blank or full game projects with optional immediate browser build.
integration: Reduces setup friction for practical use.

definition: CLI simulation feeds declared action values for a selected step count and reports state hash.
integration: Supports CI smoke tests without a browser.

definition: Every project vector asset can be materialized to an individual SVG file.
integration: Supports art review and external tooling.

definition: Project data, CSS and runtime JavaScript can be emitted into one offline-playable HTML file.
integration: Enables frictionless sharing and static hosting.

definition: The same exporter may emit runtime JavaScript as a separate file while retaining build hashes.
integration: Supports stricter hosting and debugging workflows.

definition: Browser paths, gradients, transforms, camera and z-order are rendered directly from project records.
integration: Turns authored vector assets into live game visuals.

definition: The generated runtime integrates fixed-step play, keyboard/gamepad/touch, audio, particles, HUD, pause/restart, local saves and diagnostics.
integration: Provides an actually playable dependency-free deployment target.
